simple.meaning: סָתַם (çâtham) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to stop up; by implication, to repair ; figuratively, to keep secret.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 14 times across Genesis, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, Nehemiah, Psalms, and 3 more, beginning at Genesis 26:15. Its contexts include family, kingship, city, land.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to סָתַם (H5640).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: to stop up; by implication, to repair ; figuratively, to keep secret
definitions.usage: closed up, hidden, secret, shut out (up), stop.
definitions.full: H5640. satham סָתַם verb stop up, shut up, keep close (Late Hebrew id. ; סְתַם ᵑ7 id. ; Syriac ( very rare); Arabic close door Lane 1334, and Kam Frey, are perhaps loan-words); **compare Assyrian bit sutummu , storehouse , treasury , Zehnpf BAS i. 531 . — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳ס 2Chr 32:30 ; Imperfect 2masculine plural תִּסְתֹּ֑מוּ 2Kin 3:19 ; 3 masculine plural יִסְתֹּ֑מוּ 3:25 , וַיִּסְתְּמוּ 2Chr 32:4 ; Imperative masculine singular סְתֹם Dan 8:26 ; 12:4 ; Infinitive construct לִסְתּוֺם 2Chr 32:3 ; Passive participle סָתוּם Ezek 28:3 , סָתֻם Psa 51:8 , plural סְתֻמִים Dan 12:9 ; — 1 stop up springs of water 2Kin 3:19 , 25 ; 2Chr 32:3-4 , compare 32:30 . 2 shut up, keep close , prophetic words Dan 8:26 ; 12:4 , 9 ; בְּסָתֻם Psa 51:8 in (the) closed (chamber of the breast; || טֻחוֺת ). — כָּלסָֿתוּם Ezek 28:3 usually no secret is too dark for thee, but doubtful (see II. עמם ); ᵐ5 σοφοί , Co חַרְטֻמִּים < Toy חֲכָמִים , or Berthol. קֹסְמִים . Niph`al Infinitive construct לְהִסָּתֵם Neh 4:1 the breaches [in the walls] had begun to be stopped up . Pi`el Perfect 3plural suffix סִתְּמוּם Gen 26:16 ; Imperfect 3masculine plural suffix וַיְסַתְּמוּם 26:18 , both of stopping wells quite up (R JE ). שָׂתַם verb usually stop up , in sense of shut out , shut ears against (late || form of סָתַם ; yet awkward; Ba ES 9 compare Arabic frustrate, disappoint ); — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular ׳שׂ תְּפִלָּתִי Lam 3:8 (> van d. H. שָׂתָם ) he ( ׳י ) hath shut out my prayer (Bu ׳שׂ ׳מתּ shut up [himself] from ).

occurrences.englishText: Now all the wells which his father’s servants had dug in the days of Abraham his father, the Philistines had stopped, and filled with earth.

Isaac dug again the wells of water, which they had dug in the days of Abraham his father, for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham. He called their names after the names by which his father had called them.
